source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 13: Conditional Sentences — Type 2

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.stem: If I ___ more money, I would donate to environmental charities.
starter.explanation_long: Type 2: If + Past Simple, would + V. Giả định không thực tế ở hiện tại.
starter.ielts_tip: Type 2: If + V2, would + V = unreal present.

starter.stem: If governments invested more in education, poverty ___ decrease.
starter.explanation_short: Conditional Type 2: kết quả dùng would + V.
starter.explanation_long: Type 2: If + Past → would + V (kết quả).
starter.ielts_tip: Type 2: would + V = kết quả không thực tế.

starter.stem: If he ___ the president, he would address climate change immediately.
starter.explanation_short: Conditional Type 2: If + were (cho tất cả ngôi).
starter.explanation_long: Type 2 formal: If I/he/she/it WERE (subjunctive). 'Was' = informal.
starter.ielts_tip: Type 2 formal: were cho mọi ngôi. If I were / If he were.

starter.stem: If every country ___ renewable energy, global warming would slow down.
starter.explanation_long: Type 2: If + used (Past Simple), would + V.

starter.stem: If there ___ no poverty, everyone would have access to education.
starter.explanation_short: If + were: If there were no poverty.
starter.explanation_long: Type 2: If there were (subjunctive) = giả định không thực tế.

starter.stem: If I ___ the mayor, I would build more parks.
starter.explanation_long: If I were = giả định (tôi không phải là thị trưởng).

starter.stem: If clean water were available to everyone, fewer people ___ from diseases.
If the world ___ together, we could solve global hunger.
starter.explanation_long: If + worked (Past), could + V. 'Could' = would be able to.
starter.ielts_tip: could = would be able to. Variant of Type 2.

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If I had more free time, I will volunteer for environmental projects.'
starter.explanation_long: Type 2: If + Past → would + V. 'Will' = Type 1 → sai khi if-clause dùng Past.
starter.feedback_wrong: If + Past → would. If + Present → will.

starter.stem: If every person ___ one tree a year, it would make a huge difference.

build_up.stem: If developing nations had better infrastructure, their economies ___ grow much faster.
If the Earth ___ closer to the sun, life as we know it would not exist.
build_up.explanation_short: Type 2 formal: If the Earth were (subjunctive).
build_up.explanation_long: Formal/academic English: were cho mọi ngôi trong Type 2.
build_up.ielts_tip: Academic: If + were. Informal: If + was. IELTS: dùng were.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: was (informal OK nhưng were chuẩn hơn)

build_up.stem: If international aid ___ distributed more fairly, fewer countries would suffer from extreme poverty.
build_up.explanation_long: If + were distributed (Type 2 passive), would + V.
build_up.ielts_tip: If + were + V3, would + V = Type 2 passive.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If every nation reduced its carbon footprint, the world will be a healthier place.'
build_up.explanation_long: Type 2: If + Past → would. 'Will' = Type 1 → mismatch.
build_up.ielts_tip: Type 2: would. Type 1: will. Không trộn.

build_up.stem: If governments banned single-use plastics, consumers ___ easily find alternatives.
build_up.explanation_short: If + banned (Past) → could (= would be able to).
build_up.explanation_long: Type 2: could = would be able to.
build_up.ielts_tip: could = would be able to (Type 2 variant).

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If I am the CEO, I would implement green policies immediately.'
build_up.explanation_short: would → Type 2 → if-clause cần Past/subjunctive: were.
build_up.explanation_long: If I WERE (subjunctive) = giả định, không thực tế. 'Am' = present/real → sai.
build_up.feedback_wrong: If I were = Type 2. If I am = Type 1.
build_up.ielts_tip: If I were = unreal. If I am = real.

build_up.stem: If there ___ no wars in the world, billions of dollars could be spent on healthcare.
build_up.explanation_short: Type 2: If there were = giả định.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If global leaders cooperated, emissions would decrease and the climate improves.'
options: Sai: improves → would improve (cần would trong kết quả)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: improves → would improve (cần would trong kết quả)
build_up.explanation_short: If + Past → would decrease AND would improve. 'Improves' = Present → sai.
build_up.explanation_long: Type 2: tất cả kết quả dùng would. 'Improves' = Present → inconsistent.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 Type 2: would cho mọi kết quả
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + Past, would + V and would + V.
build_up.ielts_tip: Type 2: nhất quán would cho mọi kết quả.

build_up.stem: If clean energy ___ more affordable, more people would use it.
build_up.explanation_short: Type 2: If + were (subjunctive): were more affordable.

build_up.stem: If all countries ___ their promise to reduce emissions, we would see significant improvements.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If developing countries had more resources, they will be able to provide better healthcare for their citizens.'
options: If developing countries had more resources
they will be able to provide
challenge.correct_answer: they will be able to provide
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'had' = Past → Type 2 → 'would be able to' (không 'will be able to'). Lớp 2: 'will' chỉ dùng trong Type 1.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 Type 2: would be able to (không will)!
challenge.ielts_tip: If + V2, would + V. Not will.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (had) đúng cho Type 2

options: If the government invested in renewable energy
If the government invests in renewable energy
If the government invested in renewable energy
If the government would invest in renewable energy
challenge.correct_answer: If the government invested in renewable energy, pollution levels would decrease significantly.
challenge.explanation_short: If + invested (Past) + would decrease = Type 2 chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'invested' + 'would decrease' = Type 2 nhất quán. Lớp 2: Option B trộn Present + would. Option C trộn Past + will. Option D dùng would trong if-clause.
challenge.feedback_wrong: If + Past, would + V. Nhất quán.
challenge.ielts_tip: Type 2: If + V2, would + V. Không trộn thì.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C trộn Past + will

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If every citizen was committed to recycling, and if the government was to provide better facilities, waste could be reduced by 50%.'
options: better facilities waste could be reduced
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: Academic English: 'was committed' → 'were committed' (subjunctive). Lớp 2: 'was to provide' → 'were to provide'. Cả A và C dùng 'was' → nên dùng 'were'.
challenge.ielts_tip: IELTS Writing: dùng were, không was, trong Type 2.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (was to provide → were to provide) cũng cần sửa

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT phân biệt Type 1 và Type 2:
options: more children will go to school. / If we solved poverty (unlikely)
all children would go to school.
children would go to school. / If we solved poverty
children go to school. / If we solved poverty
children go to school. / If we would solve poverty
challenge.correct_answer: If we solve poverty (possible), more children will go to school. / If we solved poverty (unlikely), all children would go to school.
challenge.explanation_short: Type 1: If + Present, will + V. Type 2: If + Past, would + V.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: Type 1 = possible → If + solve + will go. Type 2 = unlikely → If + solved + would go. Lớp 2: Option B trộn thì. Option C dùng will trong if-clause.

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN?
'If every person ___ [A] environmental issues, we ___ [B] live in a cleaner world.'
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'understood' = Past → Type 2 → would. Lớp 2: Option B trộn Present + would. Option C trộn Past + will.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 If + understood, would live = Type 2 chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: If + Past, would + V. Nhất quán.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B trộn Present + would

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If the UN would have more authority, it could enforce international environmental agreements more effectively.'
challenge.explanation_short: If + Past (had), không if + would. Would không dùng trong if-clause.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'If + would have' → 'If + had' (no would in if-clause). Lớp 2: 'could enforce' = đúng (variant of Type 2).
challenge.feedback_wrong: If + Past, would/could + V. Không dùng would trong if-clause.
challenge.ielts_tip: If + V2, would + V. KHÔNG if + would.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (could) đúng cho Type 2

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: If governments allocated more funds to research
scientists could develop more effective solutions to global warming.
challenge.correct_answer: If governments allocated more funds to research, scientists could develop more effective solutions to global warming.
challenge.explanation_short: If + allocated (Past) + could develop = Type 2 chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'allocated' + 'could develop' = Type 2 nhất quán. Lớp 2: Option B trộn Present + could. Option C dùng would trong if-clause. Option D trộn Past + will.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B trộn Type 1 + could

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If access to clean water were universal, millions of lives would be saved, and healthcare costs will decrease dramatically.'
options: If access to clean water were universal
millions of lives would be saved
challenge.explanation_short: Type 2: would decrease (không will). Trộn will = inconsistent.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'were' → Type 2 → 'would be saved' (đúng). Lớp 2: 'will decrease' → 'would decrease' (phải nhất quán would trong Type 2). Trộn will + would = sai.
challenge.feedback_wrong: Type 2: nhất quán would cho mọi kết quả.
challenge.ielts_tip: If + Past, would V and would V.

challenge.stem: Speaking Part 3: 'Nếu bạn có thể thay đổi một điều trên thế giới...' — Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: If I can change one thing
If I could change one thing
I would eliminate poverty and invest in education for all.
If I would change one thing
challenge.correct_answer: If I could change one thing, I would eliminate poverty and invest in education for all.
challenge.explanation_short: If + could (Type 2 variant) + would = chuẩn Speaking.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'could change' = Type 2 variant (would be able to change). Lớp 2: 'would eliminate and invest' = parallel results. Lớp 3: Option A = Type 1. Option C = would trong if-clause.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 If I could change, I would... = chuẩn Speaking!
challenge.feedback_wrong: If I could + V, I would + V = Type 2.
challenge.ielts_tip: Speaking: If I could + V, I would + V.

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'If every country [A] would reduce emissions by 50%, the planet [B] will be much cleaner, and future generations [C] won't face the same environmental challenges.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] would reduce → reduced. [B] will → would. [C] won't → wouldn't.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'would reduce' → 'reduced' (no would in if-clause). Lớp 2: [B] 'will' → 'would' (Type 2 result). Lớp 3: [C] 'won't' → 'wouldn't' (Type 2 negative result).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] reduced | [B] would be | [C] wouldn't face!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] no would in if. [B] would (not will). [C] wouldn't (not won't).
challenge.ielts_tip: Type 2: If + V2, would + V. Nhất quán.
